sources.name: Resort Mountain Report
sources.description: Daily official snow stake readings (24h, 48h, 7-day, season-to-date), base depths, open lift and trail counts, surface conditions, and current mountain wind holds.

sources.name: Open-Meteo High-Resolution Ensemble
sources.description: Multi-model atmospheric forecast integrating ECMWF IFS (9km), GFS (13km), and HRRR (3km). Provides elevation-adjusted hourly snowfall, cumulative curves, freezing levels (0°C isotherm), sustained wind, and gust profiles.

sources.name: NOAA National Weather Service (NWS)
sources.description: Official meteorologist forecasts, winter storm warnings/watches, quantitative precipitation forecasts (QPF), and snow accumulation probability grids from the Reno weather office.

sources.name: California Data Exchange (CDEC) & SNOTEL
sources.description: Automated physical telemetry stations measuring real-time ultrasonic snow depth, snow pillow Snow Water Equivalent (SWE), and air temperature at high-altitude mountain locations (SQV at 8,010' and WC3 at 6,750').

sources.name: Caltrans Highway Operations (QuickMap & CWWP2)
sources.description: Official real-time highway chain controls (R-0, R-1, R-2, R-3) and mountain pass closures across I-80, SR-89, SR-28, SR-267, and US-50.

blends.label: Blend
blends.description: Equal-weight mean of the six single models (NBM is left out: it is already a blend). Members missing at an hour are dropped from that hour; the blend stops when under half the member weight remains. Profile panels use the ECMWF IFS column.
